component.name: GalleryBrowser
component.summary: Linux-native asset management for images and videos

description.p: GalleryBrowser is a Linux-native gallery and asset browser for managing images and video files. It supports browsing, previewing, and organizing media assets including EXR image sequences, MOV/MP4 video files, and common image formats.

ul.li: Browse and preview images and videos in a modern dark interface
EXR image sequence playback with RAM preview
Video scrubbing and frame stepping for MOV, MP4, and other formats
Drag-and-drop file management with copy and move support
Batch rename with chainable operations and live preview
Favorites and recent folders for quick navigation

description.p: Initial release with core gallery browsing, preview, and file management features.
